title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Lemon, Pear and Raspberry E-Liquid Shortfill 100ml
description: Rachael Rabbit's Lemon, Pear and Raspberry shortfill marries the bright, sharp zest of lemon with the mellow sweetness of pears and the ruby tang of freshly picked raspberries in a captivating cocktail of exquisite fruit flavours. The bold, refreshing lemon cuts through the sweetness of both the pear and raspberry, creating a perfectly balanced yet invigorating fruity vape, enhanced with a subtle layer of ice for a clean finish. Packaged in a 120ml shortfill bottle, this product delivers 100ml of e-liquid, leaving room for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. Mixing in 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots will transform it into 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, offering flexibility in nicotine strength. The 70VG/30PG ratio ensures a perfect blend for sub-ohm vaping, producing rich flavour and ample vapour on high-powered devices. Rachael Rabbit shortfills present a savvy choice for vapers, merging economic benefits with the ability to fine-tune nicotine levels. These e-liquids are ideal for advanced sub-ohm setups, which tend to go through juice at a quicker pace. Proudly made in the UK, Rachael Rabbit specializes in complex fruit combinations, with each e-liquid boasting a trio of harmonious flavours. This commitment to quality results in layered, authentically fruity vapes that resonate with depth and complexity.
